notes: The fixture uses one Shape-C item transfer, two balance deltas, and one ownership transition per receipt.
The Parquet byte count is measured from encode_receipt_object; the ownership entry size is size_of::<OwnershipEvent>() in this build.
The re-sort vector is shrink_to_fit before an in-place unstable sort, so entries * 56 is the sort-stage heap bound.

identity.reason: ReceiptBalanceDelta and ReceiptOwnershipTransition carry AccountId directly.

layout_verdict.daily_24h_window: scan volume is plausible but a 2.39 GiB ownership sort allocation is too large for an in-process auditor default
layout_verdict.full_30d_retention: unacceptable: about 100.67 GiB scanned and 71.65 GiB retained for the ownership re-sort in the ownership-heavy arm
layout_verdict.secondary_clustering: evidence supports adding an item-clustered/indexed archive view in a separate schema decision; this change does not add one
